title: Bazil
description: The diminutive Tynnan tracker and ally of the Jedi, Bazil, relied on his incredibly hypersensitive sense of smell to track down prey from incredible distances. Tenacious, Bazil would not give up hunts easily, tracking his quarries anywhere. He accompanied the Jedi to Khofar, crying out and alerting the Jedi when his expert sense helped to discover Mae Aniseya.
